author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Softr with the AI Co-Builder to create robust apps that your business can rely on. ⭐Get 200 free AI credits - https://softr.kevinstratvert.com

Softr is an app-building platform that handles every step of the process, including web hosting, automated workflows, and database creation and management. You can build and manage every part of your app yourself and make all of the decisions. Or you can use the AI Co-Builder to help. Softr does not simply vibe-code every part of your app. Most apps can be built from native blocks, which were designed by real app builders. Native blocks are reliable and repeatable. But, the Co-Builder can vibe-code new content when needed. This video shows how to create a new app based on a brief description in the Co-Builder, then design the interface, test your app, and publish.

What you’ll learn:
• Create an app manually or with the help of the Co-Builder
• Customize your app’s interface
• Manage databases, automatically created by Softr
